title: Departments
description: Business units such as technical support or sales: their teams, SLA, working hours, AI settings and own knowledge.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view departments.
load_failed: Departments could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.
empty_description: Create the first department to separate knowledge, SLA and AI settings by business unit.
create_description: Set the department's name, teams, SLA, hours and AI settings.
detail_description: Department details, teams and shared knowledge.
columns.name: Department
validation.name_too_long: The name can be at most 120 characters.
validation.description_too_long: The description can be at most 1000 characters.
validation.instructions_too_long: Instructions can be at most 4000 characters.
validation.routing_hint_too_long: The routing hint can be at most 1000 characters.
form.section_general_desc: Name, color and how it appears in the widget.
form.section_scope_desc: Teams of the department; optional brand and the department's SLA policy.
form.section_hours_desc: Teams without their own hours use the department's.
form.section_ai_desc: How the customer AI behaves in this department and the hint for routing first messages here.
fields.name: Department name
fields.description_hint: Explains the department to customers in the widget and to the AI.
fields.widget_visible_hint: Customers can pick this department for a new conversation.
fields.teams_hint: A team belongs to one department; a team picked here moves from its old department.
fields.sla_policy_hint: Empty: brand and organization policies apply.
fields.inherit_hours_hint: Off: the department's own hours and time zone apply.
fields.ai_enabled_hint: Off: the AI hands this department's conversations straight to an agent.
fields.routing_hint_hint: When the customer does not pick one, the AI routes the first message with this hint (e.g. price, quote, purchase).
fields.ai_instructions_hint: Added to replies in this department (e.g. ask for the order number first).
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Teams and conversations lose the department. Its knowledge becomes organization-wide or moves to the department you pick.
delete.move_to: Where should the department's knowledge go?
shares.dialog_description: Let the department you pick see one item of {{name}}.
shares.no_items: The department owns no item of this kind
shares.explainer: Knowledge is closed per department by default: each department sees its own and organization-wide knowledge. A department lead can share one item with another department.
shares.empty: Nothing is shared with or by this department.
transfer.title: Transfer to another department
transfer.description: The conversation moves to the department you pick with the context you write. A team of another department is unassigned.
transfer.summary_placeholder: What does the customer need, what has been done so far?
panel.title: Department
panel.source.customer: Customer picked it in the widget
